item.title: Verath hits Kalpore coast; 40,000 moved to camps
item.description: The storm made landfall with wind speeds of 110 kmph, officials said. Around 40,000 residents were evacuated from low-lying areas.

item.title: Kestrels beat Harriers 3-1 to reach the cup final
item.description: The Kestrels scored three goals in the second half to beat the Harriers 3-1 and reach the cup final on Sunday.
